title: Agam Puram
desc: Thiru inherits a huge drug empire from Martin Fernandez. Soon, trouble follows him when his business starts affecting his family.

title: Tiger Vishwa
desc: After studying in the US, Vishwa starts living with his brother's family and gets into a tiff with two gangs. While the gangsters set out to get him, Vishwa's lover's marriage is fixed by her father.

title: Santhitha Velai
desc: During a trip, Aadalarasu meets his ailing doppelgänger, Thirunaavukkarasu, who puts forth a request. After the latter's death, Aadalarasu sets out to fulfil the promise he made to his lookalike.

title: Raja Kaiya Vacha
desc: Raja pretends to be a cop in order to impress the woman he loves, and she dumps him on learning the truth. When they meet again, he has a good job, but there is someone else who is in love with him.

title: Vetri Kodi Kattu
desc: Sekhar and Muthuraman are tricked by a con man who promises them visas to fly to Dubai. In order to protect their families from any harm, they decide to swap addresses.
